cond_0001.intro: Working on manual iOS and visionOS testing, you will be responsible for assessing the quality of new and existing AR and Spatial Computing algorithms which run on devices with LiDAR sensors. You will execute and improve test cases, as you learn about the functionality and use cases of cutting-edge algorithms. By building an intuitive understanding of these AR/VR technologies, you will be able to find scenarios and aggressors that impact their quality or performance. When finding new issues, you will gather data demonstrating the problem, document the impact to the user experience, communicate with the development team, and work with them to isolate and resolve the issue. Prior experience with live software testing is expected, preferably on iOS or other mobile devices. Experience testing or developing AR/VR technologies is also preferred. An ideal candidate will be quick to understand new technologies, creative in their approach to testing and motivated to break software so that it may be improved. This is an exciting, demanding job where you'll get to interact with prototypes and technologies under development and where your work will directly contribute to the quality of the final product.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Live testing experience (software apps or other products)
Experience with terminal or other command line tools
Able to assess and communicate issue impact and reproducibility
Organized and detail oriented
Able to manage tasks and balance their time while supporting multiple projects in parallel
Degree in engineering or an equivalent bachelor's in a relevant science such as physics or chemistry
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Reliability testing experience
Acceptance regression testing / QA experience
Preferred Requirements
Interested in Computer Vision, Augmented Reality, Virtual Reality or Spatial Computing
Mobile or VR device testing experience
Very curious, eager to learn about and break new software
Machine learning or computer vision experience

You will execute and improve test cases, as you learn about the functionality and use cases of cutting-edge algorithms. By building an intuitive understanding of these AR/VR technologies, you will be able to find scenarios and aggressors that impact their quality or performance. cond_0140.intro: Working on manual iOS and visionOS testing, you will be responsible for assessing the quality of new and existing AR and Spatial Computing algorithms which run on devices with LiDAR sensors. You will execute and improve test cases, as you learn about the functionality and use cases of cutting-edge algorithms. By building an intuitive understanding of these AR/VR technologies, you will be able to find scenarios and aggressors that impact their quality or performance. When finding new issues, you will gather data demonstrating the problem, document the impact to the user experience, communicate with the development team, and work with them to isolate and resolve the issue. This is an exciting, demanding job where you'll get to interact with prototypes and technologies under development and where your work will directly contribute to the quality of the final product. Most people become stronger in this kind of testing work over time as they build experience with AR/VR technologies and learn from the issues they find.

cond_0167.intro: Working on manual iOS and visionOS testing, you will be responsible for assessing the quality of new and existing AR and Spatial Computing algorithms which run on devices with LiDAR sensors. You will execute and improve test cases, as you learn about the functionality and use cases of cutting-edge algorithms. By building an intuitive understanding of these AR/VR technologies, you will be able to find scenarios and aggressors that impact their quality or performance. When finding new issues, you will gather data demonstrating the problem, document the impact to the user experience, communicate with the development team, and work with them to isolate and resolve the issue. This is an exciting, demanding job where you'll get to interact with prototypes and technologies under development and where your work will directly contribute to the quality of the final product. Most people become stronger in this kind of testing work over time as they build experience with AR/VR technologies and learn from the issues they find.

By building an intuitive understanding of these AR/VR technologies, you will be able to find scenarios and aggressors that impact their quality or performance. When finding new issues, you will gather data demonstrating the problem, document the impact to the user experience, communicate with the development team, and work with them to isolate and resolve the issue. Prior experience with live software testing is expected, preferably on iOS or other mobile devices. Experience testing or developing AR/VR technologies is also preferred. An ideal candidate will be quick to understand new technologies, creative in their approach to testing and motivated to break software so that it may be improved. This is an exciting, demanding job where you'll get to interact with prototypes and technologies under development and where your work will directly contribute to the quality of the final product.

By building an intuitive understanding of these AR/VR technologies, you will be able to find scenarios and aggressors that impact their quality or performance. This is a demanding job where you'll get to interact with prototypes and technologies under development and where your work will directly contribute to the quality of the final product.
cond_0339.responsibilities:
Execute and improve test cases for AR and Spatial Computing algorithms
Find scenarios and aggressors that impact quality or performance
When finding new issues, gather data demonstrating the problem and document the impact to the user experience
Communicate daily with the development team and work closely with them to isolate and resolve issues
Actively speak up when new problems arise and initiate discussions to clarify reproducibility and impact
cond_0339.requirements:
Interest in Computer Vision, Augmented Reality, Virtual Reality or Spatial Computing

Mobile or VR device testing experience preferred
Experience with terminal or other command line tools
Able to assess and clearly communicate issue impact and reproducibility to the team
Very curious, eager to learn about and break new software
Organized and detail oriented
Able to manage tasks and balance time while supporting multiple projects in parallel
Degree in engineering or an equivalent bachelor's in a relevant science such as physics or chemistry
Reliability testing experience

Experience with acceptance and regression testing
QA background

cond_0381.intro: Working on manual iOS and visionOS testing, you will be responsible for assessing the quality of new and existing AR and Spatial Computing algorithms which run on devices with LiDAR sensors. You will execute and improve test cases, as you learn about the functionality and use cases of cutting-edge algorithms. By building an intuitive understanding of these AR/VR technologies, you will be able to find scenarios and aggressors that impact their quality or performance. When finding new issues, you will gather data demonstrating the problem, document the impact to the user experience, communicate with the development team, and work with them to isolate and resolve the issue. Prior experience with live software testing is expected, preferably on iOS or other mobile devices. Experience testing or developing AR/VR technologies is also preferred. An ideal candidate will be quick to understand new technologies, creative in their approach to testing and motivated to break software so that it may be improved. This is an exciting, demanding job where you'll get to interact with prototypes and technologies under development and where your work will directly contribute to the quality of the final product.
cond_0381.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Interest in Computer Vision, Augmented Reality, Virtual Reality, or Spatial Computing
Around a year or more of live testing experience (software apps or other products), or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Familiarity with terminal or other command line tools
Ability to assess and communicate issue impact and reproducibility
Curiosity and willingness to learn about and break new software
Organized and detail oriented
Ability to manage tasks and balance time while supporting multiple projects in parallel
Bachelor's degree in engineering or a relevant science such as physics or chemistry, or equivalent practical experience
Working knowledge of reliability testing and acceptance/regression testing
Comfort with verbal and written communication
Preferred Requirements
Background in mobile or VR device testing
Exposure to Machine Learning or Computer Vision concepts

By building an intuitive understanding of these AR/VR technologies, you will be able to find scenarios and aggressors that impact their quality or performance. When finding new issues, you will gather data demonstrating the problem, document the impact to the user experience, communicate with the development team, and work with them to isolate and resolve the issue. This is an exciting, demanding job where you'll get to interact with prototypes and technologies under development and where your work will directly contribute to the quality of the final product. Most people become stronger in this kind of testing work over time as they build experience with AR/VR technologies and learn from the issues they find.

cond_0498.intro: Working on manual iOS and visionOS testing, you will be responsible for assessing the quality of new and existing AR and Spatial Computing algorithms which run on devices with LiDAR sensors. You will execute and improve test cases, as you learn about the functionality and use cases of cutting-edge algorithms. By building an intuitive understanding of these AR/VR technologies, you will be able to find scenarios and aggressors that impact their quality or performance. When finding new issues, you will gather data demonstrating the problem, document the impact to the user experience, communicate with the development team, and work with them to isolate and resolve the issue. Prior experience with live software testing is expected, preferably on iOS or other mobile devices. Experience testing or developing AR/VR technologies is also preferred. An ideal candidate will be quick to understand new technologies, creative in their approach to testing and motivated to break software so that it may be improved. This is an exciting, demanding job where you'll get to interact with prototypes and technologies under development and where your work will directly contribute to the quality of the final product.
